# `fintech_posted_only_on_active_accounts`

> Frozen and closed accounts cannot have posted movements.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `status <> 'posted' or account_status = 'active'`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_posted_only_on_active_accounts`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`closed_account_activity`**: posted transaction on a closed account.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=closed_account_activity BATCH=2026-10-20_closed_account_activity
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_closed_account_activity
```
